title: Collections
lead: Group claims and sources into lists. Keep them private or share them with a link.

empty.title: No collections yet
empty.body: Create one above to keep related claims and sources together.

items.title: Items
items.empty: This collection is empty. Open a claim or source and use Add to collection.

delete.title: Delete this collection
delete.body: This removes the collection and its list. The claims and sources in it are not affected.
delete.confirm: I want to delete this collection

share.title: Share
share.private: Only you can open this collection. Change who can open it in Details to get a link.
share.label: Link to share
share.hint: Anyone with this link can read the collection. They cannot change it.
